title: Governance Metadata
description: Provenance and trustworthiness envelope attached to every pipeline output. Fields match REQUIRED_GOVERNANCE_FIELDS in tools/lib/common.py.

source_class.description: Provenance class of the data that produced this output.

provenance_chain.description: Ordered list of provenance entries tracing this output back to its inputs.

confidence_level.description: Confidence in the output's accuracy. 'high' when no UNRESOLVED fields; 'medium' otherwise.

verification_status.description: Whether a human has confirmed the output against source material.

patch_era.description: Star Citizen patch version in effect when this output was produced, or 'UNRESOLVED'.

telemetry_support_level.description: Degree to which this output is backed by real session telemetry.

operational_assurance_state.description: Maturity/validation state of the scoring logic that produced this output.

unresolved_field_list.description: List of field names in this output that carry the UNRESOLVED sentinel.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Outputs from this pipeline are advisory, never authoritative.

contributor_trust_tier.description: Trust tier of the source or contributor. T0 = system-generated; T4 = unvetted external.

derivation_type.description: Label for the specific pipeline stage or algorithm that produced this output.
